heirlooms.pre_war_origin: Graduation gift from Leningrad Medical Academy, 1952
heirlooms.physical_condition: Tarnished brass binaural tubes, cold silver chestpiece, cracked black rubber hose
heirlooms.sensory_memory_text: The chill of the silver bell against warm skin. The steady, galloping rhythm of a healthy heart before the dust settled. She listens to her own pulse when the clinic is empty.
heirlooms.item_loss_event_text: The rubber hose split during emergency surgery. Dr. Vel sat in the dark holding the silver bell, unable to speak for six hours.

heirlooms.pre_war_origin: Machinist 6th-Grade Certification Tool, Kharkov Locomotive Works, 1961
heirlooms.physical_condition: Deeply etched metric markings, polished jaws, slight bluing on locking thumb screw
heirlooms.sensory_memory_text: The silky slide of the vernier scale. Measuring tolerances down to one-twentieth of a millimeter. It smells of light spindle oil and forty years of honest machine work.
heirlooms.item_loss_event_text: Dropped into the foundry slag trough during a stoking accident. Oleg didn't swear; he simply went to his bunk and stared at his empty hands.

heirlooms.item_name: Pressed Apple Blossom in Waxed Parchment
heirlooms.pre_war_origin: Picked from the orchard behind her family home on the morning of October 13
heirlooms.physical_condition: Fragile translucent petals pressed between two sheets of yellowed paraffin paper
heirlooms.sensory_memory_text: A faint hint of dried sweetness and honeyed spring air. It reminds her of bees buzzing under midday sunlight, something the children underground have never seen.
heirlooms.item_loss_event_text: Moisture seeped into the parchment envelope, turning the petals to dark mold. Elena wept quietly into her seedling peat trays.

heirlooms.pre_war_origin: State Weights & Measures Bureau Verification Standard #442
heirlooms.physical_condition: Solid cylindrical brass with lead adjustment plug in base; worn mirror-bright from finger polish
heirlooms.sensory_memory_text: The reassuring cold density in the palm. The conviction that truth exists, that half a kilo of rye flour is exactly half a kilo, even if the world above is ashes.
heirlooms.item_loss_event_text: Stolen from the warehouse desk during a food riot. Harlan refused to weigh grain with uncertified stone weights for three days.

heirlooms.pre_war_origin: Seventh birthday gift from her grandmother in Riga
heirlooms.physical_condition: Small chip on the porcelain lid; brass comb plays four measures of a lullaby before sticking
heirlooms.sensory_memory_text: The gentle tinkle of four steel tines striking brass pins. In the silence of the residential cubicles, it sounds like raindrops hitting a glass bedroom window.
heirlooms.item_loss_event_text: The mainspring snapped with a loud twang during a night watch. Sonya held the silent box against her cheek until dawn.

heirlooms.item_name: Whittled Pine Fox with Glass Bead Eyes
heirlooms.pre_war_origin: Carved by his younger brother Misha during winter break, 1979
heirlooms.physical_condition: Darkened pine wood with pocket-knife whittle facets, two amber bead eyes glued with resin
heirlooms.sensory_memory_text: The rough ridges of pine wood smoothed by thumb rubbing. He remembers sitting by the kitchen stove listening to Misha whistle while wood shavings fell onto the rug.
heirlooms.item_loss_event_text: Lost in the snow outside Airlock 2 during a blizzard reconnaissance run. Stepan searched the drift with bare hands until frostbite set in.

heirlooms.pre_war_origin: Issued by Northern Mineral Expedition #14, 1968
heirlooms.physical_condition: Heavy copper casing, sapphire pivot jewel, needle points true north despite magnetic dust
heirlooms.sensory_memory_text: The liquid swing of the blued steel needle settling onto magnetic north. A reminder that the earth is still round and spinning, regardless of the firestorms.
heirlooms.item_loss_event_text: Glass cover cracked and fluid leaked out after a fall in the drainage adit. Boris kept the dry needle aligned with a pocket magnet.

heirlooms.pre_war_origin: Passed down through four generations of village weavers
heirlooms.physical_condition: Warm honey-colored amber beads polished by generations of fingers; knotted silk cord
heirlooms.sensory_memory_text: Holding amber against wool produces a faint electrostatic crackle and the scent of ancient pine resin. Each bead represents a prayer for those buried in the shale.
heirlooms.item_loss_event_text: The silk cord snapped during a burial in the crypt; amber beads scattered into the dark fissures. Dwellers crawled on knees to recover thirty-two of them.

heirlooms.pre_war_origin: Recovered from amateur radio club station UK5UBB
heirlooms.physical_condition: Black bakelite housing with two nickel prongs; stamped 7050 kHz in faded white paint
heirlooms.sensory_memory_text: The resonant hum of the 40-meter amateur band. Taras remembers summer nights chatting with operators in Prague and Tokyo through crackling static.
heirlooms.item_loss_event_text: Over-driven with plate voltage during a dead-hand storm alert, fracturing the internal quartz wafer. Taras lost his primary calling channel.

heirlooms.pre_war_origin: Awarded for 20 years service on the South-Western Railway, 1974
heirlooms.physical_condition: Engine-turned silver backplate, enamel dial with bold black numerals, loud ticking lever escapement
heirlooms.sensory_memory_text: The steady, resolute tick-tick-tick of mechanical time. When all electric clocks died in the EMP, this spring-driven balance wheel kept the shelter's shift schedules running.
heirlooms.item_loss_event_text: Balance staff broken when Ilya dove under a bench during a blast tremor. The sudden silence made the chemical lab unbearable.

heirlooms.pre_war_origin: Purchased in Tallinn Woodworking Guild, 1958
heirlooms.physical_condition: Yellow boxwood with brass pivot joints, deeply stamped millimeter scales with brass tips
heirlooms.sensory_memory_text: The rhythmic snap-snap-snap of opening ten hinged links. Smells of linseed oil and cedar. Every door and bunk in the shelter was measured with this yellow stick.
heirlooms.item_loss_event_text: A falling mine timber crushed the rule at the 140cm hinge. Mikhail carefully spliced it with brass wire and kept using it.

heirlooms.pre_war_origin: Used in the Army Uniform Workshop #4, 1955
heirlooms.physical_condition: Deep pitted dimples on crown, custom bent lip to fit Grigory's scarred middle finger
heirlooms.sensory_memory_text: Pushing sailcloth needles through eight layers of rubberized hazmat fabric. The familiar weight on his fingertip makes fifty repairs a day feel like second nature.
heirlooms.item_loss_event_text: Fell through the floor grating into the sewer sump. Grigory spent three hours sifting sludge with a magnet until he found it.

heirlooms.pre_war_origin: Stitched by her daughter Katya before her school trip to Kiev
heirlooms.physical_condition: Soft homespun white linen with faded blue cross-stitch cornflowers in one corner
heirlooms.sensory_memory_text: Tucked inside her apron pocket. Pressing the soft linen to her eyes between shifts gives her the strength to stir twenty gallons of turnip broth without crying.
heirlooms.item_loss_event_text: Scorched by a flying coal spark from the galley range. Anna sewed a patch of gray wool over the burn mark.

heirlooms.item_name: Faded Polaroid of Mother on a Garden Bench
heirlooms.pre_war_origin: Taken on July 20, 1982 in Yalta
heirlooms.physical_condition: Chemical print with water ring stains on border; colors faded to sepia and dull magenta
heirlooms.sensory_memory_text: Her smiling face behind a glass of sweet tea. Victor tapes it to the steel inside of his helmet so she is the last thing he sees before donning his gas mask.
heirlooms.item_loss_event_text: Decontamination spray washed out the emulsion, leaving a white ghost silhouette. Victor kept the blank paper in his breast pocket.

heirlooms.pre_war_origin: Lomonosov Porcelain Factory, part of a wedding dowry set, 1965
heirlooms.physical_condition: Delicate gold floral filigree on rim; hairline crack stabilized with cyanoacrylate glue
heirlooms.sensory_memory_text: Drinking hot chicory tea from bone china instead of tin mugs. It transforms a miserable subterranean breakfast into an act of dignity and civilization.
heirlooms.item_loss_event_text: Shattered when an airlock shockwave rattled the cupboard. Klara swept the porcelain shards and kept them in a velvet pouch.

heirlooms.pre_war_origin: Used by his father in the municipal shoe repair cooperative, 1948
heirlooms.physical_condition: Solid 4 kg cast iron with three foot horns; polished smooth from thousands of nailed leather soles
heirlooms.sensory_memory_text: The solid ringing thud when driving brass tacks into birch bark insoles. As long as Yuri can rebuild boots, dwellers can walk through winter snow.
heirlooms.item_loss_event_text: Misplaced during the evacuation to Sub-4. Yuri refused to mend a single shoe until sappers retrieved it from the flooded adit.

heirlooms.pre_war_origin: Gift from a reindeer herder in the Northern Urals, 1970
heirlooms.physical_condition: Silky yellowed elk bone with a finely polished hook; carved knotwork spiral on handle
heirlooms.sensory_memory_text: Crocheting bandages from spun cotton scrap during quiet night clinic shifts. The rhythmic loop-pull-loop calms shaking hands after amputations.
heirlooms.item_loss_event_text: Snapped while pulling heavy hemp cord. Sofia smoothed the broken tip into a stylus for marking patient chart slates.

heirlooms.pre_war_origin: St. Petersburg Precision Instrument Works, 1950
heirlooms.physical_condition: Heavy brass chassis with adjustable pitch vial filled with green mineral spirit
heirlooms.sensory_memory_text: Watching the green bubble settle perfectly between two fine etched lines. When building retaining walls against sixty tons of shale, level is survival.
heirlooms.item_loss_event_text: The glass vial broke during rock blasting. Artem replaced the tube with water and a drop of kerosene.

heirlooms.pre_war_origin: Rescued from the Municipal Library shelf during the 30-minute alert
heirlooms.physical_condition: Cracked brown leather spine with gold embossing; rag paper pages scented with dry vanilla and age
heirlooms.sensory_memory_text: Reading 'Eugene Onegin' aloud to the children by candlelight. The rhythm of classic poetry drowns out the heavy rumble of the ventilation fans.
heirlooms.item_loss_event_text: Water dripping from a condensation pipe soaked fifty pages. Galina ironed every leaf dry with a warm tea tin.

heirlooms.pre_war_origin: Chief Structural Engineer's Personal Rule, Dam Project 1964
heirlooms.physical_condition: White celluloid facing on mahogany core with glass cursor hairline in brass frame
heirlooms.sensory_memory_text: Calculating blast overpressure, structural deflection, and air filter throughput in seconds. Dmitri trusts these logarithmic scales more than any computer.
heirlooms.item_loss_event_text: Glass cursor cracked during a vault cave-in. Dmitri scored a replacement hairline on clear mica sheet.

heirlooms.item_name: Hohner Marine Band Harmonica in Key of C
heirlooms.pre_war_origin: Purchased from a Polish sailor in Port Morozov, 1978
heirlooms.physical_condition: Pearwood comb with brass reed plates and embossed steel covers; slightly dented corner
heirlooms.sensory_memory_text: The soulful, trembling wail of blues and waltzes echoing down the exhaust shafts after the night shift. Dwellers stop arguing when Nadia plays.
heirlooms.item_loss_event_text: A reed clogged with coal ash during a furnace blowback. Nadia disassembled the plates and cleaned them with alcohol.

heirlooms.item_name: Navy Officer Sterling Silver Anchor Cufflinks
heirlooms.pre_war_origin: Commissioning gift from Northern Fleet Submarine Brigade, 1971
heirlooms.physical_condition: Cast sterling silver miniature foul anchors with pivoting toggle bars; tarnished grey
heirlooms.sensory_memory_text: He keeps them pinned inside his hazmat chest pouch. When crawling through radioactive fog, touching the cold anchors reminds him he survived thirty submarine patrols.
heirlooms.item_loss_event_text: One cufflink fell off in the Crater Marsh mud. Pavel refused to wear the remaining one, keeping it in his matchbox.

heirlooms.pre_war_origin: Harvested from her apiary in the valley orchards, August 1982
heirlooms.physical_condition: Heavy clear glass jar with lead-foil beeswax seal; amber liquid clover honey crystalizing slowly
heirlooms.sensory_memory_text: Golden clover honey. Untouched by radioactive strontium. A spoonful is administered only to dying dwellers or children with acute respiratory fever.
heirlooms.item_loss_event_text: Opened on Day 1000 to save little Masha from severe diphtheria. Larisa kept the empty jar with the wax seal.

heirlooms.pre_war_origin: Brought back from Prague during military service, 1968
heirlooms.physical_condition: Aged dark briar bowl with teeth marks on vulcanite stem; charred rim
heirlooms.sensory_memory_text: Smoking dried raspberry leaves and wild mint in the briar bowl. The familiar wooden warmth in his teeth grounds him during endless perimeter watches.
heirlooms.item_loss_event_text: The vulcanite stem broke when Konstantin slipped on icy ladder rungs. He whittled a replacement stem from elderberry twig.

heirlooms.item_name: Solingen Steel Folding Knife with Stag Horn Handle
heirlooms.pre_war_origin: Gift from her grandfather for harvesting edible mushrooms, 1973
heirlooms.physical_condition: Stag horn scales pinned with brass rivets; drop point blade sharpened to razor edge
heirlooms.sensory_memory_text: The satisfying snap of the backspring lock. Harvesting lichens, paring turnip skins, or scraping lead paint off scavenged cans—this blade never fails.
heirlooms.item_loss_event_text: Blade chipped on an iron cable in the ruins. Tamara spent two days reshaping the bevel on a water stone.

heirlooms.pre_war_origin: Found in his coat pocket when evacuating the kindergarten, October 1982
heirlooms.physical_condition: Lead figurine on charging horse; red jacket paint chipped, sabre slightly bent
heirlooms.sensory_memory_text: The weight of real cast metal. Valery marches the lead horse along the bunker bunk edges, inventing battles where the cavalry always rescues the lost city.
heirlooms.item_loss_event_text: Fell into the ventilation intake duct. Engineer Dmitri unscrewed the grate to retrieve the toy for the boy.

heirlooms.item_name: Tula Imperial Brass Samovar Valve Key
heirlooms.pre_war_origin: From the grand brass samovar that heated tea for twenty cousins every Sunday
heirlooms.physical_condition: Heavy cast brass cock with ornate trefoil handle; polished yellow
heirlooms.sensory_memory_text: Turning the key in her fingers. The memory of bubbling tea water, charcoal smoke, and the laughter of twenty relatives gathered around the dining table.
heirlooms.item_loss_event_text: Misplaced during flour milling. Oxana stopped kneading dough until her apprentices found it under the flour sack.

heirlooms.pre_war_origin: Optical bench calibration artifact, Zeiss Jena laboratory, 1966
heirlooms.physical_condition: 60-degree high-dispersion flint glass prism with ground bases; pristine optical faces
heirlooms.sensory_memory_text: Holding it up to a candle flame splits the yellow light into a brilliant rainbow across the gray concrete wall. It shows the children what color looks like.
heirlooms.item_loss_event_text: Corner chipped on a brass caliper. Timur ground and polished the facet flat again with rouge.

heirlooms.pre_war_origin: Inherited from her mother upon delivering her hundredth infant in 1969
heirlooms.physical_condition: Hand-chased filigree vine pattern with hallmark stamp; oxidized dark patina
heirlooms.sensory_memory_text: Sewing the flannel swaddling cloths for the three babies born in the shelter. The silver touch is a promise that new life will keep arriving.
heirlooms.item_loss_event_text: Dropped into the maternity wash basin. Recovered before the rinse cycle began.

heirlooms.item_name: Walnut Carved Seed Box of the Century Seed
heirlooms.pre_war_origin: Crafted by her grandfather in 1945 from a single piece of upland walnut
heirlooms.physical_condition: Deeply carved relief of oak leaves and acorns; sliding dovetail lid; holding the golden apple seed
heirlooms.sensory_memory_text: The box that carried the single heirloom apple seed through ten years of dark winter. Opening the sliding lid reveals the tiny brown seed that will grow into the Century Tree.
heirlooms.item_loss_event_text: Emptied on Day 3650 when Sonya planted the seed into the Sunken Atrium mountain soil under the open sky.
